player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Recreation room and Attic, repeatedly going east and then west. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and avoid revisiting them. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also try to explore other rooms that I haven't visited yet, such as the Bathroom and the Guest room.
